contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban running routes: a tree-lined riverside promenade with a city skyline, a sloping residential lane with a stone step, a shaded pavement past hedges and low apartment blocks, a street-side drinking fountain, and a riverside railing with apartment blocks and a bridge; hard direct sun with sharp shadows, blue sky and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted; the wet paving at the fountain is fountain water. The East Asian urban region and the humid setting are the producer's reviewed mapping; humid is a styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the user explicitly approved these five female running editorials and full automation of this batch (userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true; 2026-11-07). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The riverside railing, the river, the bridge and the buildings are the setting, not products. She is seen from behind while stretching, so the racerback singlet's front and the shorts' front are conservatively reconstructed from the visible back and sides, and the watch dial is inferred. Both runners and both socks are visible and listed as pairs. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual worn silhouettes, colors and accessories matched. Hidden fronts restored conservatively.
First singlet source alpha flecks evaluated at final 500px: no visible floating debris on any background.

copy.titleEn: A LONGER BREATH BY THE RIVER

title.en: A longer breath by the river

deck.ko: 버건디 레이서백과 차콜 쇼츠의 간결한 마무리.
deck.en: Burgundy racerback and charcoal shorts make a simple finish.
deck.de: Burgunderrotes Racerback und anthrazitfarbene Shorts bilden den Abschluss.

intro.ko: 난간에 손을 두고 종아리를 늘리며 뒤를 돌아봅니다.
intro.en: Hands on the railing, a calf stretch ends with a glance back.
intro.de: Mit den Händen am Geländer endet die Wadendehnung in einem Blick zurück.

body.ko: 등이 좁아지는 버건디 싱글릿과 몸을 따르는 차콜 쇼츠가 서로 다른 길이를 만듭니다. 회색 양말과 흰 신발은 짙은 색 아래 밝은 끝점을 놓습니다. 은색 시계 테두리와 흰 측면 라인이 작게 빛나며 움직임 뒤의 휴식을 정돈합니다.
body.en: The burgundy racerback singlet and close-fitting charcoal shorts create distinct hem lengths. Gray socks and white shoes add a light endpoint beneath the deeper colors. A silver watch rim and small white side lines bring a restrained highlight to the pause after movement.
body.de: Das burgunderrote Racerback-Singlet und die körpernahen anthrazitfarbenen Shorts setzen unterschiedliche Saumlängen. Graue Socken und weiße Schuhe bilden einen hellen Abschluss unter den dunklen Farben. Silberner Uhrenrand und kleine weiße Seitenlinien ergänzen den ruhigen Moment.

pull.en: Keep the finish as clear as the start.
pull.de: Den Abschluss so klar halten wie den Start.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Keep the finish as clear as the start.

tip.ko: 싱글릿을 쇼츠 밖으로 내려 길이 차이를 살리고 양말 입구는 접지 마세요.
tip.en: Leave the singlet untucked and the gray sock cuffs unfolded.
tip.de: Das Singlet über dem Bund und die grauen Sockenbündchen ungeklappt tragen.
